headline: House resolution to formally censure Representative Rashida Tlaib was tabled and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have formally censured Representative Rashida Tlaib of Michigan. A censure is an official statement of disapproval by the House. Its title accused her of antisemitic activity, sympathizing with terrorist organizations, and leading an insurrection at the Capitol complex. The House voted to table it on November 1, 2023, so it was not adopted.

who_it_affects.how: She would have received a formal reprimand from the House, though the summary does not describe any other penalties.
